newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian parliament adopts 1997 budget - paper.
newsitem.headline: Serbian parliament adopts 1997 budget - paper.

text.p: The Serbian parliament has approved the 1997 republican budget of 14.065 billion dinars ($2.74 billion), a Belgrade newspaper reported on Thursday.
Serbia's Finance Minister Dusan Vlatkovic told the parliament that the 1997 budget was 17.2 percent up on the 1996 budget, the daily newspaper Nasa Borba said.
The minister said 68 percent of the total budget will be used for public sector and administration wages and for social security payments, the paper reported.
Another 10.8 percent of the budget is for special purpose funds while material expenses will account for 9.4 percent of the budget, the paper said.
Funds for stimulating the economy are planned at 1.85 billion dinars, while agricultural funds are budgeted at 930 million dinars.
Vlatkovic said that 85 percent of the budget income will be generated from sales taxes, excise duties and income tax.
